name: Sandnes Open 2020
information: **English:** Welcome to Sandnes Open 2020! The competition will use almost the same format as the Sandnes competitions from previous years, but this year there will be some fewer events. The competition is free to attend for everyone - even for the competitiors. **Norsk:** Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2020! Konkurransen vil ha ca samme format som de tidligere Sandnes-konkurransene, men i år er det noen færre grener. Konkurransen er gratis for alle - også for deltakere.
